label: Equipment
description: Equipment panel immediately after opening: no forced hover, tooltip, candidate preview, or slot filter.

label: Equipment Hover (Equipped)
description: Hover an equipped item to verify the equipped-only tooltip presentation.

label: Equipment Hover (Duplicate)
description: Hover an iron-helm bag item while an identical iron helm is equipped in Head. The paired tooltip must report no stat delta.

label: Equipment Hover (Empty Slot)
description: Hover leather boots in the bag while Feet is empty. The candidate tooltip must show the empty-slot comparison and stat delta.

label: Equipment Hover (Stats delta)
description: Hover a non-duplicate candidate for an already occupied visible slot. The paired current/candidate tooltips must show a non-zero stat delta.

label: Equipment Hover (Ring Replacement)
description: Hover a third ring while Ring 1 and Ring 2 are occupied. The comparison must make the replacement target clear without covering either ring slot.

label: Equipment Hover (Ring Ambiguity)
description: Hover a Bag ring compatible with Ring 1 and Ring 2. Both targets remain visible and the comparison is unambiguous.

label: Equipment Hover (Mixed Direct Deltas)
description: Hover an occupied-slot candidate with positive and negative direct stat deltas. Only bold parenthesized deltas carry green/red color.

label: Equipment Hover (Bag Boundary)
description: Hover a bottom visible item in a scrolled Bag and keep the comparison contained, clear of the target, and on its safe side.

label: Equipment Hover (Scrolled Bag Target)
description: Hover a compatible item after scrolling several Bag rows. The comparison remains anchored to the visible cell rather than stale pre-scroll geometry.

label: Equipment Hover (Multi-Hand Replacement)
description: Hover a two-hand Bag weapon while Main Hand and Off Hand are occupied. The paired comparison must preserve both targets and avoid misleading duplicate deltas.
